coaching_implication: Acceptable if framed as a deliberate scope-hold, but the rep should explicitly validate the customer's point ('that's exactly why locking in a lower rate now matters') rather than silently pivoting past it.

quote: Okay. I'll call you back. Bye.
stewart_read: The call ends with the customer, not the rep, defining the next step, and no day/time/callback commitment was captured. This is a textbook unanchored soft exit — no handshake, no locked appointment, no rep-owned follow-up.
coaching_implication: This is the clearest structural miss on the call: the rep should never let the customer close the call with a vague self-initiated promise. Practice ending every call with a specific day/time ask, even on a soft lead.
